name: eslint
title: ESLint rules for apps
description: agent-ui/no-raw-layout flags flex/grid/inline-flex/inline-grid (any variant, ! marker) in className strings, cn()/clsx()/cva() arguments and template literals, but does not follow identifiers or constants; agent-ui/no-literal-ui-text requires useT() for JSX text, string children (through ternaries and &&/||) and text props such as title, label, placeholder, aria-label. Add ...agentUi() to eslint.config.js (R1, i18n).
